basis: Business criticality tiers are human judgements for the LoanEase sandbox, not scan output. Backup facts come from loanease-sim's Terraform (modules/backup): a daily DLM policy (03:00 UTC, retain 3) targets volumes tagged Backup=true; only the DB volume carries the tag. No restore test has been run, so last_tested_at is null. Fields nothing establishes (rto_hours, immutable_copy) are null, not guessed. Asset links use the EC2 instance and root-volume ARNs Prowler observed (instance-to-name mapping read from `aws ec2 describe-instances`, 2026-09-25), because the host:<ip> assets need Wazuh/Greenbone, which are unreachable in this sandbox. host:<ip> links attach once the Wazuh and Greenbone exports are supplied (their connectors identify hosts by private IP; the Wazuh manager host, which has no usable IP in agent_control, is identified by its name). The same machine then appears twice, as a host: asset and a cloud: ARN asset, until identity resolution merges them.
